cards.name: Platinum Exclusive

fee_waiver.text: KFS says lifetime free; the schedule of charges shows AED 250 waived while segment eligibility holds

rules.name: Special categories
rules.conditions: supermarkets, telecom, fuel, education, government, charities, transport, rentals, insurance and fast food earn 1 pt per AED

cards.notes: Earn: 2.5 pts per AED in the UAE (about 0.88%), 3.5 pts on non-AED spend, 1 pt in special categories; cap 999,999 pts/month. Merchant category is whatever the merchant registered, so mis-categorised spend cannot be disputed. Official figures from NBF's Platinum KFS (Apr 2025): annual fee lifetime free, minimum salary AED 9,000, 2.5% foreign-currency processing fee, 2.99%/month interest, late fee AED 230, cash advance 4% or AED 50, 2 free supplementary cards. CONFLICT: the July 2025 Personal Banking Schedule of Charges lists AED 250 for the Exclusive card (waived while segment eligibility holds); the KFS is the card-specific document so lifetime free is used. The KFS names only 'cashback' without rates, while the rewards page describes points; the points structure is kept. Joining fee not stated in any document.

cards.name: Infinite

fee_waiver.text: KFS says lifetime free; the schedule of charges shows AED 750 waived while segment eligibility holds

rules.name: Special categories
rules.conditions: supermarkets, telecom, fuel, education, government, charities, transport, rentals, insurance and fast food earn 1 pt per AED

lounge.text: Visa Airport Companion app lounge access (details not stated on page)

cards.notes: Earn rate depends on banking segment: NBF Al Samy customers 4 pts/AED local and 6 abroad; NBF Priority customers 3.5 local and 5 abroad (used as base, the conservative figure); rate for customers outside those segments is not stated. 1 pt in special categories. Cap 999,999 pts/month. Official figures from NBF's Infinite KFS (undated, hosted under 2025/02 uploads): annual fee lifetime free, minimum salary AED 40,000 or NBF Priority segment, 2.5% foreign-currency processing fee, 2.49%/month interest, late fee AED 230, cash advance 4% or AED 50, 3 free supplementary cards (AED 250 from the fourth). CONFLICT: the July 2025 Schedule of Charges shows AED 750 waived while segment eligibility holds. The KFS describes a spend-tiered cashback (1% to 2% domestic, 2% to 3% abroad, by monthly spend band, expiring after 2 years) which differs from the points programme on the rewards page; points structure kept pending clarification.

cards.name: Classic
cards.notes: Verified from NBF's Classic KFS (June 2025 upload): annual fee lifetime free, minimum salary AED 5,000, Visa, 2.5% foreign-currency processing fee, 2.99%/month interest, late fee AED 230, cash advance 4% or AED 50, 2 free supplementary cards (AED 100 from third). No points programme described; cashback only on special offers. CONFLICT: July 2025 Schedule of Charges lists AED 100 for Classic (and also 'life-time free' in a shared column); KFS used. Joining fee not stated.
